scope_note: Annotation-derived single-hop design over image text proxies only. The 3,356-row corpus contains 2,000 ESC-50 category-only audio metadata rows and 1,356 image annotation/text-proxy rows; no audio files/recordings or raw image media are available to this audit. Audio labels are not presented as real recordings, and image descriptions are not raw-image understanding. These questions are not independent held-out evaluation items.
